| | Dear Friend,

C.S. Lewis and J.R.R. Tolkien wrote some of the twentieth century's most beloved works of literature, including robust defenses of the Christian faith.

Today, I want to share an exclusive and free video series with you that considers Lewis and Tolkien in the context of their membership in the Inklings--an informal professor-student literary group at Oxford in the 1930s and 40s.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series about the Inklings by using this secure link now:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/the-inklings-cca](https://links.conservativesgive.com/s/c/O68nYQRmNwlYxTcjeVxb50wl8WChuTx77hkG1FwKrO1hyN7p6Dq6yBAj6spnfGZeAJG6lLBWY2GtExzDzfM5IIBboRyVEMaGzNgqomR5t8XXeAtLLqrfgRQlg_GcaqG_K0Z1CMIyS505RLAcgh8e4n3pEABxnluh32l_XZgd1DapsOrVy2n-TOE_7_FCBLdRQqrFwKcHSRaSjj5eo9T-1Fpxh0TJsQNFH94LdZicJEIaYmLSFGOSyjIfxs3TnP-uxNViWXjlKVse9yVY9nub99DjBCE-cOHpUe90A_dzhuvXmvWwzo1yXVDx0oFAkyzPoNKgSxuCB2xV4PEily_CAFXo_7uwaEg9UduVSjkUpopfh3XBTvHVOnoU9_TFkhYGKkc3oKBUH-1b41GQYyNJrIDB2lV51-NDreybJEKwcr23ItvexyPh/GJ-CMEsN2pdIFiH3cOl4Uixl2Zev6fge/7)**

C.S. Lewis is best known for his Narnia books--such as _The Lion, the Witch, and the Wardrobe_ --and his apologetics, including _Mere Christianity_. Indeed, Lewis is one of the greatest Christian apologists of all time.

J.R.R. Tolkien's most renowned works are _The Hobbit_ and _The Lord of the Rings _trilogy.

That both were men of genius is indisputable. Both men also devoted countless hours to honing their craft. This included subjecting their writing to the scrutiny of their fellow Inklings, who met regularly for conversation and to read aloud from and discuss their current work.

**The Inklings are a fascinating topic of study, which is why we 've created a free online video series for you to enjoy. **

The video series, titled "The Inklings," was filmed on the Hillsdale College campus. It examines the ideas that bound the Inklings, what they accomplished, and the continuing importance of their works today--with a special focus on Lewis and Tolkien.

**You can use the secure link below to receive instant access to "The Inklings" free video series:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/the-inklings-cca](https://links.conservativesgive.com/s/c/PQIZVmTxi3VUWvbppoUyGHnkXwAZ8EGFR1uBZGyLCdTFN6evLdhXAXcEebOiDleyHSct0fpNzOTGlm62Xt3nfOlEwEnR6bl_pjoGOR4IQFStCjxAgJss1o1Ah_G3ZwBYaws9wPXd2_vQmZ48A9cM-dKm8butcAR8HmizdfTKCOpQaSING9ZQVXfcawJikI5oRQ8L2XD9T23_kmteYaIyPJBLUB1tzhJQc_jjwTTzE2zyQCbd504cYYUk8PPhe6ksgadAb61TNOmdWUNomXn-vbUCtj9Z5vorcblI2zLKfcOP1AfDSdPGOD9ldRBWJzjNuJ7Jn8zEKQ1vLmOzdZ-CQMg42EjFkAMOWMpnX4m3pntgEMEkKK4MVxJ7VTG2AIEl71YmwRQEyMeTIm1WNiTCQKd7nbX7iU-ZMYYT9KU3PV8bRbofBt4-/jqpz0qdpkR6cIh2XJdzX0IwJNtxARhkZ/7)**

Lewis and Tolkien thought the Inklings' meetings contributed significantly to their literary success. As models of civil discussion and intelligent debate, they stand in stark contrast to today's "cancel culture."

The Inklings, are therefore, worth studying not only for their great literary achievements but also because they exemplify the free speech that is essential to the pursuit of truth.

That's why Hillsdale College created a free online video series on the Inklings. I hope you'll use the secure link above and start watching it today.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. C.S. Lewis and J.R.R. Tolkien met regularly with an informal literary group named the Inklings.

Now, you can examine the philosophical, theological, and literary ideas that bound the Inklings together with a free video series from Hillsdale College.

Fellow patriot – I’ve spent some of the best years of my life fighting to save America from the radical left. Sometimes, that meant sacrificing the things I cherish most.
I’ve missed birthdays, special occasions, and time with my family because I know the future of our country is on the line.

This isn’t just politics for me - it’s personal.
My father, a veteran, taught me what it means to love our country. My mother, the strongest woman I know, poured everything into raising our family. Even when I go months without seeing them, they understand why this fight matters and why I’ll never stop.

_**How We Flipped Pennsylvania**_

When the establishment wrote off Pennsylvania, we _dug in_. We didn’t just talk - we acted. We trained thousands of grassroots volunteers, sent teams door-to-door in deep-blue counties, and**we registered over 70,000 new Republican voters**. We took the fight straight to the Left’s ballot-harvesting operations, outworked them, and **_we delivered Pennsylvania for President Trump_**.

**_Now, We’re Doing the Same in New Jersey_**

The Democrats think New Jersey is safe. They think their machine will keep them in power. But we’re proving them wrong.

* We’ve already registered tens of thousands of**new Republican voters**.
* We’re building a **ballot-harvesting army** to compete where it matters most.
* We’re targeting **key swing districts** that could tip the balance of power in 2024.

**_Here’s Where You Come In_**

We’re running a full-scale ground operation in New Jersey **_[but we need the resources to finish the job](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/abT6/?__vbtrk=MjgwNjIwOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjgwNjIwOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_.**

**We flipped Pennsylvania.****Now, let’s flip New Jersey.**

**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi folks,
Just a reminder that you can listen to the Mountain Minute now every morning! Click [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).****Here is a summary of today's top stories:
**🏛️ Colorado Legislative Session Updates...** SB25-1269 advances with [strict emissions targets](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), sparking concerns over rising costs. Lawmakers weigh [nuclear energy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as a clean power solution, but will Polis sign it into action? A proposed bill would create a new "veterinary professional associate" position to address Colorado’s vet shortage, but [voters already weighed in](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on the matter.
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** CMU students clash over [Turning Point USA polls](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), debating free speech vs. hate speech. A major drug bust uncovered fentanyl and the dangerous [elephant tranquilizer](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) xylazine, intensifying concerns over Colorado’s drug crisis.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Recently released documents reveal new details, fueling speculation about the full story behind [President Kennedy’s assassination](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Meanwhile, reports show Border Patrol has [seized more eggs than fentanyl](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) this year.
🗣️ **Commentary Spotlight...** An op-ed by C. J. Garbo questions Biden’s use of an [autopen for key legislation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Greg Walcher argues that lawsuits and bureaucracy are harming wildlife more than responsible [forest management](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Rick Meckstroth warns that declining civic education threatens America’s future, highlighting the [Leadership Program of the Rockies](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as a solution.
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, March 20, 2025.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Hate or free speech? CMU students react to local Turning Point USA polls](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Few things stir debate on college campuses like politics—and at CMU, a student group’s whiteboard polls have done just that. Turning Point USA’s Colorado Mesa University chapter (TPUSA CMU) has sparked discussion after posting a series of provocative whiteboard poll questions in the university’s cafeteria.
Some students view the questions as open discussion starters, while others see them as hate speech meant to provoke.
“Some of the questions pertaining to immigrants and other situations going on, you have to understand a lot of people are going through this personally,” CMU student Welam Agamba told KKCO 11 News.
Founded by Charlie Kirk in 2012, TPUSA is known for challenging anti-American perspectives on college campuses across the nation.

**[Colorado moves toward a nuclear future as energy demands skyrocket](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* House Bill 25-1040, which designates nuclear energy as part of Colorado’s clean energy portfolio, has passed both chambers and now awaits Governor Jared Polis' decision. While conservatives see this as a step toward energy independence, Polis faces pressure from progressive climate activists.
* With the Craig Station Power Plant set to close and electricity demand expected to double by 2050, local leaders on the Western Slope are actively exploring small modular nuclear reactors (SMRs) and fuel recycling technologies to sustain reliable power.
* Polls show strong backing for nuclear in Colorado, putting pressure on Polis to decide between energy independence or climate activist demands.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

**[Garbo: Biden’s autopen scandal—who was really running the country?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_The recent revelation that an autopen was used to affix President Joe Biden’s signature on numerous executive orders, pardons, and other documents of national consequence is a scandal of seismic proportions._
_If proven true, this practice strikes at the very heart of the legitimacy of executive authority and raises grave constitutional concerns that demand immediate and thorough investigation._
_The use of a machine-generated signature to execute the powers vested solely in the President of the United States by the Constitution is not merely a matter of procedural convenience – it is a fundamental betrayal of the American people and the democratic principles upon which this nation was founded._

**[Walcher: Squirrels Killed by the Forest Service, or the Courts?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY GREG WALCHER | COMMENTARY | MARCH 19** _In 2017 the Arizona Game and Fish Department estimated that there were only 252 Mount Graham red squirrels left. They only inhabited a few hundred acres in the 10,000-foot Pinaleño Mountains, not equipped to survive the heat of the surrounding deserts._
**[Meckstroth: A Well Informed Citizenry...](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY RICK MECKSTROTH****| COMMENTARY | MARCH 19** _Thomas Jefferson has a very famous quote: “A well informed citizenry is the best defense against tyranny.”_ _At a conference this past weekend, I saw a great example of how well (or poorly) informed we are that came from a recent study conducted by the The Institute for Citizens and Scholars (formerly Woodrow Wilson National Fellowship Foundation)._ __

GREG WALCHER | COMMENTARY | MARCH 19 In 2017 the Arizona Game and Fish Department estimated that there were only 252 Mount Graham red squirrels left. name: Kirk Cameron
subject: This revival mission needs you!
body:
It may seem a little early to be talking about Easter, but it's really only weeks away.

| | | Brave Books is spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" revival campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate...
---
| |
---
| | Dear Fellow Believer, It may seem a little early to be talking about Easter, but it's really only weeks away.And in that short amount of time, my friends at Brave Books are spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate......to Jesus.And this revival mission needs you! My friend, if you've seen me talking about Brave Books on Fox News, you know their mission is to counter the ungodly lies being pushed by the Left in schools, libraries, and Hollywood......by creating high-quality, wholesome, and Godly books and entertainment that instill conservative values and Gospel lessons in our children. And their "Prepare the Way" revival campaign is their biggest effort yet to point parents and children to the empty tomb and God’s redeeming love.Here’s exactly what their strategy is...First... Brave Books knows that families need an easy and impactful way to counter the Left's secularization of Easter and instead, captivate children with its true meaning. So, they created _Saving the Easter Bunny_ , a brand-new children's book that's destined to be a classic.In it, Ronnie the Rabbit learns the hard way what sin is and that our Lord Jesus Christ loves us so much that he took the punishment for that sin.Jesus is represented by a powerful lion named Lord Joshua and the book beautifully portrays his resurrection and God's never-ending redeeming love for us. It's incredible.And let me tell you, parents are hungry for content like this because everywhere they turn godlessness is being pushed by schools, left-wing publishers like Scholastic, and Hollywood. When Brave Books first introduced a God-centered Christmas game called "_Mouse in the House_ ," to counter the secular elf game that has become so popular -- it sold out in THREE HOURS!That's why step one of Brave Books' "Prepare the Way" revival, is ramping up the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ big-time. **[And today I'm hoping you'll help them kick it into high gear before orders start pouring in by rushing back your best "Prepare the Way" gift.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z0dforeeqien0oe3nfn97uekumvqjl555gutau5o_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c5ge1oj2cth2bs)** No family should go without this wonderful book because of overwhelming demand. Second... Recognizing that families who want to raise their children with wholesome Christian values often feel alone in their mission...Brave Books is launching a 17-city traveling church tour that starts in Ponta Vedra Beach, Florida and ends in Laurel, Mississippi. I'll be leading the tour in every city as we prepare our hearts and our families for Easter through prayer, worship, music, and just some good old-fashioned conversation about raising Godly children in our godless culture.Our church tour aims to ignite a spirit of revival in thousands of families this Easter season and I can't wait to see what God makes of that! But getting our worship teams, musicians, and all the rest to 17 different cities for thousands of families to enjoy won't be easy and it won't be inexpensive.But I know we can do it.Brave Books is a small Christian company founded by a doctor named Trent Talbot. After having his first child, he saw how the Left was using books and entertainment to turn the hearts and minds of America's children away from God. And so he decided to take action and with the help of believers just like you, look at what they've already done:
---
>>> They've countered the Left's radical and ungodly "Drag Queen Story Hours" and filled children's hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God with their highly-publicized "See You at the Library" campaign. Armed with Brave Books' "See You at the Library" kits, thousands of parents, grandparents, children, and concerned citizens have gathered at over 360 libraries in 49 states to take back our libraries.>>> Created an historic TV show called "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" to fight the ungodly lessons coming out of Hollywood. It's our modern day "Mr. Rogers' Neighborhood" funded by everyday Americans who want to return American culture to God. "Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk" uses humor and storytelling to reinforce the traditional biblical values that have made America great.>>> And now you are crucial to the success and failure of our "Prepare the Way" revival campaign which features the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ and a 17-city church tour.
---
And listen to this...**[**Your "Prepare the Way" gift of $35, $50, $100 or more, not only helps fund this revival campaign that makes Jesus the reason for the Easter season once more...**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z238bk6uemit97v2ga5v5f5ef06q043kpuur3n5g_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c5ge1oj2cth2bs)** Your gift helps Brave Books complete a groundbreaking comprehensive homeschool curriculum that gives parents an alternative to woke government schools.AND your gift helps Brave Books begin work on an historic Gospel book series that will bring the Bible to life for a generation of children and parents in desperate need of God's truth. But nothing Brave Books accomplishes is possible without you. And if you need one more reason to help, when you **[contribute $100 or more to the "Prepare the Way" revival](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zi50hc7opfjulfrvaarfb8ng4rqp8405f462qr50_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c5ge1oj2cth2bs)** , Brave Books will send you _Saving the Easter Bunny_ absolutely free as a thank you. You can keep _Saving the Easter Bunny_ for your family, gift it to someone you love, or you can donate it to your favorite charity in the hopes of reaching a family who doesn't have a Christian role model in their life. **[**What's most important is that you rush back your best "Prepare the Way" gift of $35, $50, $100, or more right away.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zo8qcggc3t9htsjvd1pkiqvdksmuh3208006blio_rp22sh2s8i6eob2c5ge1oj2cth2bs)** Thank you for bringing the true meaning of Easter to families all across America.
---
May God bless you this coming Easter season,
---

GOP Rep. Burgess Owens grilled Jessica Levin, Litigation Director for the Education Law Center, for opposing school choice while **[benefiting from an elite private education herself.](https://substack.com/redirect/cdb8401c-8568-45b2-a81e-d1f371fa89f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Watch her get called out in front of the entire nation for her unbelievable hypocrisy!
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/cdb8401c-8568-45b2-a81e-d1f371fa89f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/cdb8401c-8568-45b2-a81e-d1f371fa89f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"I'm very impressed with your background," Owens told Levin. "Magna cum laude from Cornell University, University of Oxford,... I'm gonna guess that's because you had a remarkable foundation. You had parents that truly focussed on your education, is that correct?"
Levin agreed.
"Would you have had the same experience you think if you lived in the Baltimore area with 28 schools, you have 2,000 seniors with zero proficiency in math?" the congressman pressed. "75% of boys could not pass reading and writing tests. Could you have succeeded in those kind of conditions, in those public school systems?"
"We need to fully fund our public schools to make sure that all students have the opportunity," Levin answered.
Owens interrupted, asking Levin blankly "did you go to public school?"
"No I went to private school..." she answered.
Owens **[revealed her to be a perfect hypocrite](https://substack.com/redirect/cdb8401c-8568-45b2-a81e-d1f371fa89f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , benefiting from elite educations while trying to remove that option for American families and force children to endure public school.
Watch how he hammers the point and doesn't let her off the hook:
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/cdb8401c-8568-45b2-a81e-d1f371fa89f1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

# [Condemn the Trump administration for trying to erase Iwo Jima hero Ira Hayes](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta40e0f4c-1725-41f7-858e-a547301af59e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | Ira Hayes was one of the Iwo Jim flag-raisers featured in one of the most famous photos ever. And this war hero was a Native American, something proudly featured on the Pentagon site – [until Trump officials “erased” Hayes](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8a3dc306-d00a-4fb6-a7bf-1a47b3fc3966/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) and removed the mention, because of their truly deranged obsession with DEI. [Add your name now, and demand that Hayes’s page be put back NOW.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T05997540-9c6f-4879-b71b-a0ff7a9f98db/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Hayes was one of the soldiers pictured in the iconic photograph, Raising the Flag on Iwo Jima, and depicted in the statue that was created in its image. To erase this American hero from history is despicable. To erase him because he wasn’t white is truly abhorrent. The Trump administration needs to hear our outrage and know that they cannot erase history. [Sign your name to condemn Trump and his administration for trying to erase Iwo Jima hero Ira Hayes. And demand that Hayes’s page be put back NOW >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0baec386-d8aa-480b-acd6-da9113ea2dc0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: Claire Low, All On The Line
subject: For the first time in nearly three decades
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
It was a stand for fair representation, voting rights, and justice.
|
---

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/104168014/534533854/-766669867?refcode=don_aotl_tier1_email_OTDLA4_email_20250320-AOTL-Tier1-OTDLA4-CL_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20250320-AOTL-Tier1-OTDLA4-CL_&utm_campaign=OTDLA&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImE0MDkxMzNjLThiMDUtZjAxMS05MGNkLTAwMjI0ODJhOWZiNyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=fNCRhsSQmakry12u3bspLV9u5sC6sVRqLegNkuL8y8Q=)
---
Peter,
Last November, something happened for the first time in nearly three decades: Louisiana elected two Black members of Congress.
Take it from me, someone whose job includes analyzing the consequences of election results — this was about more than deciding which candidates would serve in office. It was a stand for fair representation, voting rights, and justice.
And it happened because Black Louisianans had newfound freedom to exercise hard-won political power.
This month, you’ve gotten emails from several of my colleagues at All On The Line about the backstory behind this election, the new fair map that made it possible, and how that map is now up for review at the U.S. Supreme Court.
Louisiana’s population is about one-third Black — yet until recently, because of gerrymandering, Black Louisianans only had the ability to elect the candidate of their choice in one of the state’s six U.S. House districts.
**Because Louisiana voters — with support from our affiliate, the National Redistricting Foundation — challenged that gerrymandered map in court, the state was forced to draw a new congressional map finally providing Black Louisianans with the equal representation they deserve under the Voting Rights Act.**
In 2024 — for the first time in decades — there were two districts where Black voters had the opportunity to elect candidates of their choice, instead of just one.
This additional district transformed political representation for Black Louisianans. Communities that had been split across multiple districts to dilute their voting power were finally united with a meaningful voice in Congress. Voters who had been effectively silenced finally had the opportunity to see their priorities and concerns addressed by a candidate of their choosing.
As Congressman Cleo Fields said before his election to represent the newly redrawn 6th District:
_"It's important that every person in the state has the opportunity to elect a candidate of their choice...**At the end of the day it makes Democracy better when people are included."**_
Since his swearing-in at the beginning of this year, Congressman Fields has hosted a series of town halls to hear from constituents in Baton Rouge, Lafayette, Alexandria, Shreveport, Opelousas, and Natchitoches.
Here’s how local news station KALB described one of those sessions:
_“Throughout the meeting, Fields addressed a wide range of issues raised by his constituents, from the ongoing insurance crisis and homelessness to food insecurity, veterans affairs, and concerns about potential cuts to funding for Historically Black Colleges and Universities as well as Medicaid... Fields added that he plans to take the concerns he heard tonight and work on them in Congress.”_
Every American should have an equal opportunity to make their voice heard in our democracy — from town halls to the ballot box — and hold their leaders accountable.
But in Louisiana, the fight for equal participation is far from over.
**Next week, the U.S. Supreme Court will hear oral arguments in a case that could overturn Louisiana’s fair map — ripping rightful representation away from people who finally won it.**
**No matter what happens next, All On The Line will keep exposing the realities of gerrymandering, mobilizing our grassroots movement behind fair maps in Louisiana and around the country, and advocating for the principle of equal participation in our democracy.**

Peter,

It's me, Tommy Tuberville.

Throughout my life, I've been called many names. Whether it's Coach, Dad, Husband, or Senator, I've always led by example for the people who depend on me.

**This email is a little longer.** [**I 'm humbly asking you to read it through and consider donating to my re-election campaign for the United States Senate when you're finished.**](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=2ed65f275f4b4ddc934fbcb99226ef14&_e=va_-YXFezHTAJnBk4bEZ91p35JBe8no7DaM3VAQa7uRhNp7yVf-gGldqCYl3cyHQZDEjsVTDR4HQBuiGo1-BcuVsYHuL--kpS9sNpcUSS-isBhRcGd4G7LjpEGelZtcyyRenPRLzXHok78ffFAyvuvMPXSnInGHfYwkeGYhA6lJCLsQrejrkwGg0M4a5AvMjLTQB8oVGgcgtPWJxzmp-O2uRp_vIlr-wvzNOz_4CyYIFfE3oGAcXQFgWk3H7oT5oqJblG5gFWSiWMqyh3lTgTjIwDzhFCth9-lF-BRDMm2Qx9nLiePZooGstE40GYq7cmey4csGZSRP3PfWb-F4wyg%3D%3D)

[](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=2ed65f275f4b4ddc934fbcb99226ef14&_e=va_-YXFezHTAJnBk4bEZ91p35JBe8no7DaM3VAQa7uRhNp7yVf-gGldqCYl3cyHQZDEjsVTDR4HQBuiGo1-BcuVsYHuL--kpS9sNpcUSS-isBhRcGd4G7LjpEGelZtcyyRenPRLzXHok78ffFAyvuvMPXSnInGHfYwkeGYhA6lJCLsQrejrkwGg0M4a5AvMj28FDGmxkevm-0Ln8UeXla0-CgVSEUkgQ4Pe24VZ60wfS-O9aeC7_aJdtBq7dUX2QmNSVh0W87P1rSvHzpfVCXSnlJDdnimrwkJaRujuIWPilXe-BIcwLZjILM7-y9eem36G1AdLyguFqUbZkiAYO8A%3D%3D)
I was born in Camden, Arkansas as the third of three children to my parents, Olive and Charles Tuberville. They raised me to always work hard and stand on principle, which I've brought with me in every step of my life.

I met my wife, Suzanne, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans in 1989. We married just three years later and have two amazing children together, Tucker and Troy. They continue to make me proud every single day.

[](http://links.tubervilleforalabama.com/u/click?_t=b8b4efbe79f64b579dfa7d8da685a7a9&_m=2ed65f275f4b4ddc934fbcb99226ef14&_e=va_-YXFezHTAJnBk4bEZ91p35JBe8no7DaM3VAQa7uRhNp7yVf-gGldqCYl3cyHQZDEjsVTDR4HQBuiGo1-BcuVsYHuL--kpS9sNpcUSS-isBhRcGd4G7LjpEGelZtcyyRenPRLzXHok78ffFAyvuvMPXSnInGHfYwkeGYhA6lJCLsQrejrkwGg0M4a5AvMjwrExdWY-szknSYS8LyoKya65BthMjMsFIM8NMnuu2eJzdVJelsQedXFYHYL7FsXGuUgWCJzFRQpqgEviEKJx5IkGe-cdYeqocP4WKIfuBuwhwo6y1_X7xKN64EPRNK3APiFp8jiOPM6Bde6wFMnkqQ%3D%3D)
After graduating from SAU, I took my first coaching job at Hermitage High School before graduating to the college level as an assistant coach at Arkansas State University.

Just two years later, I started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, where I went on to become their defensive coordinator. This is a deep red district that went for Trump by a whopping 64%. If the National and FL GOP wanted to, they could marshal so much money into this district, at such an early point, that we'd never have a shot.
But in this we realized that we could turn the GOP's many strengths in FL-06 into a weakness.

name: Wes Moore
subject: What’s bringing you joy right now?
body:
We all need something to keep us grounded right now. For me, it’s the simple pleasures: Spending time with my family (and our dog, Tucker), watching Maryland sports, and being in the great outdoors.

I always love enjoying quality time with my family, especially our dog, Tucker! We adopted him two years ago, and he’s part Shih Tzu, part Poodle. He’s an absolute delight to have around and makes spending time together even more special.

Wes and Tucker [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90457/images/wes_favthings1.png]

I’m always tuned into sports. Right now, I’m watching a ton of college basketball, and I’m pumped for the Orioles’ home opener on the 31st. Go Terps and let’s go O’s!

Wes in an Orioles jersey [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90457/images/wes_favthings2.jpg]I also enjoy spending time outside and, thankfully, our state's parks are the perfect place to get active. I recently took a hike at Downs Memorial Park, and saw a pair of deer strolling by!

Wes at a state park [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90457/images/wes_favthings3.png]

Now that I’ve shared a few things that make me happy, I want to know: What’s bringing you joy right now? Reply to this email to let me know!

I can’t wait to read your response.
Elevate,
Wes

subject: Peter, is market risk rising?
body:
| Hi Peter, After reaching more new highs recently, markets have pulled back and gotten choppy.1 Let's break down what's happening and why it matters. **What's driving recent volatility?** Concerns about the impact of inflation and tariffs on consumer sentiment are one major driver.2 If Americans lose confidence in the economy, they may pull back on spending, which is the biggest driver of economic growth. Federal workforce reductions are also adding to the uncertainty. The new administration has implemented significant changes by laying off thousands of newer employees and offering buyouts to many more.3 It's not yet clear what the long-term effect of these job cuts may be, but the impact may radiate out to other areas of the economy if workers can't find new jobs and households cut back spending. If you or someone close to you has been impacted by layoffs, please reply to this email and let me know. We can navigate the financial changes together. **Why I'm cautiously optimistic about markets despite the uncertainty** The good news is that Q4 corporate earnings look very positive so far.4 If trends continue, we could see the largest year-over-year earnings increase since 2021.
---
|
---
Many companies are also reporting better-than-expected results, suggesting business conditions were stronger than anticipated.5 With today's high stock valuations, continued earnings performance remains critical for market growth. If business performance doesn't keep up with expectations, we can expect a pullback. **What does this mean for your portfolio?** As you already know, pullbacks and volatility are a normal part of investing, especially during periods of major uncertainty. When we built your portfolio together, we designed it to help weather these kinds of fluctuations while positioning you to pursue your goals. When markets retreat, and you start to get nervous, it's natural to wonder if you should be in the market at all. It's a completely normal experience as an investor. But letting your feelings drive your investment decisions doesn't typically yield great results. In fact, it often accomplishes the opposite. **Abandoning your strategy when markets get choppy and uncertain may mean locking in losses and potentially missing out on future market opportunities.** But it doesn't mean we hold fast to a strategy that no longer fits current conditions. That's where my team and I are working hard. We're monitoring developments closely. We can't predict the future, but we can use data and experience to help you chart a course. As always, I'm here to discuss your thoughts, concerns, and worries (as well as celebrate your successes). Please reach out if you'd like to talk or get my perspective on markets. That's what I'm here for. Sincerely,
---
**Reid Rasner - CEO**

subject: What is our purpose?
body:
Theology 101

_**A message from our sponsor...**_

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=3fa8b8640c654661a978f2d43b702512&_e=4DFg4oXfV8Id-vWrCIXISOZHgL4tMHhtmvPGfZ4c2I-fwkx50Bcu-fX-HuvEstlTpeF_jL6_Mw-hrtxAcUkUdPHf6u1JSBuVhKOFu8XU8prlNx-9Nlh0wWunFGsIARFnEjnFWAPPDD0z2CZiJVjolXOhvrT0aeWedG1JbzUc2YcZFfO9ihLCILWUwV6oA0SwfFCqx7MsMV1OCSU2z6HcUR8bsUpB9kdf3aNfhIVh4TTWgsy3uAi7eZMSxxEWEVFdSiRF7OT62-7FKQjB-EOAvO78KynunR34rPDEOxPKYT1kvwEo02GDJc3wSVcO5ZzjKSJCwGyJHOhrYcKram7SRVlcXcT52PqC4IbWw1zd6CK_J86UdGGkMsFvKvteSiUEQiGY13iAIYNVevze-W5UrJ6MWtA3973clDpsD0o5K7bMe8nae_Njs0l0WPknwiUM) Dear Fellow American, I hope your day is going well. I’m writing to let you know about something I think you’ll find useful in your learning. Reason and speech are gifts from God that enable us to think about God and to worship Him. [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=3fa8b8640c654661a978f2d43b702512&_e=4DFg4oXfV8Id-vWrCIXISOZHgL4tMHhtmvPGfZ4c2I-fwkx50Bcu-fX-HuvEstlTpeF_jL6_Mw-hrtxAcUkUdPHf6u1JSBuVhKOFu8XU8prlNx-9Nlh0wWunFGsIARFnEjnFWAPPDD0z2CZiJVjolXOhvrT0aeWedG1JbzUc2YcZFfO9ihLCILWUwV6oA0SwfFCqx7MsMV1OCSU2z6HcUR8bsUpB9kdf3aNfhIVh4TTWgsy3uAi7eZMSxxEWEVFdSiRF7OT62-7FKQjB-EOAvO78KynunR34rPDEOxPKYT31WxnNhkm0hrwdUlJXEm71royFXmwitREY7qkQrUJ01Bp8Ed0X8odvBSZzj4xlGhRCqH2ajHhHZiG8kF6DVlE9kLn8P6do7GMax8jD3oaYXQYXXbyvGiVpsSwjFaGEBYYTjwRqtiAPO1Qn7oGFKd7-) One of the chief aims of education at Hillsdale College is to understand what kind of being we are, as well as our purpose. That, in turn, makes it possible to begin to understand our relationship to God.

The study of God, also known as “theology,” has had a profound impact on Western civilization, stretching back thousands of years to the ancient Hebrews. And that’s what Hillsdale’s **“Theology 101”** online course is about—the development of theology from the Old Testament through the twentieth century.

Here's the bad news--some Republicans in the House just voted to try to gut Medicaid by $880 billion, to fund yet another round of tax giveaways for the wealthiest Americans. If Congress ultimately passes a bill that gets to the President's desk, they will strip healthcare from up to 80 million seniors, children, disabled people, and families already struggling with the high costs of care, all to benefit 800 ultra-rich billionaires and a few hundred mega-wealthy corporations.
But the good news is - the fight isn't over. Congress hasn't finalized the cuts yet, and we still have time to stop them. If there was ever a moment to raise our voices, this is it. Leading national organizations like Caring Across Generations are mobilizing caregivers, advocates, and community members across the country to meet directly with their lawmakers while they are back home in their districts.
In this piece I help make sense of this confusing budget debate, where it stands right now, and share what me and you can do to help stop this disaster before it's too late. **Let 's Address This.**

## **What This Budget Vote Means**
While Congress has voted on a budget resolution that includes devastating Medicaid cuts, the process is far from complete. House and Senate Republicans must come to an agreement on an identical budget resolution, rather than what we have now - two dueling budget resolutions that share two different sets of instructions to legislative committees. The details of these cuts still need to be finalized through legislative committees, where lawmakers will decide exactly how to implement them. After the committees, the House and Senate both have to vote on the floor - marking an additional opportunity to try to stop their cuts from happening. **That means there is still a critical opportunity to fight back and make sure these cuts never become reality.**
At the heart of this issue is a simple truth: the proposed Medicaid cuts would take away health care and aging and disability care from those who need it most, all to fund trillions in tax breaks for the wealthiest Americans and big corporations. This is not about balancing the budget. It is about prioritizing the rich at the expense of families who rely on Medicaid for essential care. Medicaid supports nearly 80 million Americans--including seniors, disabled people, children, and families struggling to make ends meet. In fact, 41% of babies born every day in the U.S. are to families who utilize Medicaid for their lifesaving care. Medicaid means people see doctors when they're sick, get critical treatments like chemotherapy and surgeries, and receive aging and disability care in their homes and communities, where people want to receive it. These cuts will reduce access to care, raise health costs, increase financial instability for millions, and result in a rise in infant and maternal mortality.
**And let me be absolutely clear about one thing.**
The impact of these cuts won't be confined to one political party, one region, or one economic class: Medicaid affects all people in the U.S. No matter where you live or who you vote for, the consequences of stripping away this vital program will ripple through communities across the country. Hospitals will close (particularly in already underfunded rural America), home healthcare workers will be laid off, disabled people and older adults who need care will have to go without, and families will be left to shoulder stupendous medical costs on their own. Emergency rooms will become even more overcrowded, and life-saving treatments will be delayed or denied. Families will be forced to make impossible choices between paying rent and seeking medical care--yes, even worse than it already is where some 500,000 Americans annually file for medical bankruptcy.
This is not a partisan issue--it is a moral one. And this is not a hypothetical scenario. It is what will happen if these cuts go through. That is why we must act now.

## **We 're Fighting Back--And You Can Too**
Caring Across Generations is actively mobilizing caregivers, advocates, and community members in California, Michigan, Georgia, and Illinois to meet directly with members of Congress while they're back in their districts. These in-district visits are already underway, making this a crucial moment to demand they protect Medicaid.
**Here 's what you can do:**
**📝 Sign the petition.** Even if you can't attend in person, your signature matters. Every name is another reminder to Congress that we won't back down.
[Petition to Protect Medicaid](https://substack.com/redirect/38b92634-cf08-43ef-bbfd-8a8793aeda49?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**📞 Make noise.** Call your representatives in Congress. Be relentless until they can't ignore us. Let them know: if they vote to gut Medicaid, we will remember in November.
[Call Your Rep In Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/5ecec858-724c-439a-a1e9-2ddb5ef50ff8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**📢 Follow & share.** Get the latest updates from Caring Across Generations on social media @caringacrossgen, and stay tuned.
[Follow @CaringAcrossGen](https://substack.com/redirect/bba42499-bb04-4268-91e3-36b4410e6889?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
## **Conclusion**
Yes, the situation is dire. But no, we are not powerless. If we organize, we can win. These cuts are not final, and with enough pressure, we can stop them.
But we must act now.
Medicaid is not just a line item on a budget. It is a lifeline for millions of families. We know how this playbook goes. They chip away at our rights, hoping we're too exhausted to resist.
We're not exhausted--we're ready to fight. Speak out. Sign the petition. Show up at their offices. We must protect Medicaid now - because care can't wait.
**The fight to stave off fascism funded by billionaire oligarchs isn 't easy. I cannot do it alone. Subscribe below and join the movement.**

Peter, We see it every election cycle. By the time the general election rolls around, our ballots are full of candidates–but
|

| Peter, We see it every election cycle. By the time the general election rolls around, our ballots are full of candidates–but there don’t seem to be any on the side of Common Sense New Jerseyans. There are precious few candidates we can count on to be on the side of immigration enforcement, government transparency, anti-corruption, or lower taxes – and even fewer who will actually do what they say they support. Instead, every name on the ballot seems to be full of “Lemons” hand-picked by the elite establishment. And it’s pretty clear that their interests and ours are rarely aligned. At the Common Sense Club, we have decided that enough is enough. There’s a place for the megaphone and for calling attention to a problem.
---
|
# But the primaries are only 3 months away. Time is running out for us to weed out Lemon candidates by turning out the vote for June.
---
| So we’re setting down the megaphone (to be picked back up, for sure!) and getting to work on this. We started the One Less Lemon project to mobilize more Common Sense voters to get to the polls in June. We urgently need your help. Here’s what you can do.

We’ve all been there, Derek.
It’s hard to look away from the chaos and dysfunction of Washington. You open up social media or turn on cable news to try to keep up, and suddenly hours have passed.
**But, there’s a difference between staying informed and getting sucked in.**
And, we all have a choice to keep doom scrolling or to get up and do something. The best remedy to hopelessness is _action._ Find something concrete you can do, and make it happen!
That’s why I’m running for Governor. I’m not going to sit on the sidelines while Donald Trump and his cronies trample on our rights and run our economy into the ground.
**[I hope you’ll do something, too, by chipping in $5 to help power this campaign.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_kp_20250320_1_ak?refcode=em20250320-39557&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39557_3422442_5w_fOZ&akid=39557%2E3422442%2E5w_fOZ)**
If you can’t chip in right now, or if you’ve already donated and are looking to take another few steps, consider calling your Congressperson about a bill that’s important to you, or volunteer in your community (it can be political or not)—anything concrete that moves the ball forward, even an inch.
Another piece of free advice from me if you’re still having trouble motivating yourself off the couch: find something you’re already passionate about, and channel that energy into action.
It’ll make you feel better to see the difference you’ve made, and you might just make a few friends along the way. I know I have.
Plus, social media and cable news will still be there when you’re winding down from the day you’ve had.
Onward,
Katie

I’m a doctor, not a politician. I care deeply about families, public health and advocating for Ohioans who are struggling. But when Governor DeWine asked me to join his administration as Director of the Ohio Department of Public Health in 2019, I had no idea what was to come. When COVID-19 spread like wildfire I worked side-by-side with Democrats and Republicans alike to defend Ohioans against the pandemic, the scourge of opioids, and fight for public health across our state. I believe that the best way to find solutions and help people is to work with folks from all walks of life and with all different viewpoints. And that’s exactly how I will lead as Governor. The problems we face don’t care if you’re a Democrat or a Republican. They just need fixing. And Peter, I don’t care if you’re a Democrat or a Republican, either. I’ll fight for you and your family just the same. But I can’t win this race alone, that’s why I’m asking for your help today because we have set a goal to raise $50,000 to kick off this campaign. | | | I am genuinely sorry, Friend.

Really, I am.

I am sorry some folks don't even thank you for donating.

_It is enough to drive you nuts. And I completely understand how you feel because I get the same messages._

**This is Steve Scalise. First of all, I want to personally thank you for everything you 've done to help elect President Trump and Republicans thus far. _[You are the lifeblood of the MAGA movement- and we only won with your hard work and support.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=c5b767bc893b42feb41304ab4ff62df9&_e=tcRZn43rq-EMsEeuSgQrnOn01ebMCuNJ5adtsPuLI_tKIUI7NLZ_uH1MrbIu_BnnQPtK6qCLi-GMlZsLbJaZkGdI2hj4paMM0hteSWOmWuTwV3-_J4YmfnZhxKNOuA9z99YrR0x81mh_obiMs5ZeXww7KlBjtiX7kHPC_eA7qF4eniGW5mZsgygw9Gu7HV2O95FlgquHjyQ44a_5iiK3ief33ZZKGHb_MfOYxlFFPp10V9X99xlLSJ-jqnbjwDUfTUGJpElkE0b7dbriknNNicCiS1QKrYnNEZq6ClHQspJ3wwlVNeJOtv7GEHZVDxMqEUSUlytSkrjt4NM335DkAAmVmT9BBRO_hgEsVARmkec1mF9mlJyrFQ8G2Naut0XmVLjdaXm3C_7mPWTi_kB62Kb7XrAi-c_uKeEWd_rLMlI%3D "You are the lifeblood of the MAGA movement – and we only won with your hard work and support.")_ **

Thank you for having the grit and determination to stand up to the Democrat Machine at the height of its power.

Unfortunately, the Democrats have regrouped faster than anyone thought possible.

They're ALREADY unloading 50 million dollars into enough battleground districts to flip the House. They've ALREADY tried delaying GOP victories by postponing elections. And they're ALREADY dragging President Trump and Elon Musk into court.

_**[In other words, we really need some more support right now to keep fighting.](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=c5b767bc893b42feb41304ab4ff62df9&_e=tcRZn43rq-EMsEeuSgQrnOn01ebMCuNJ5adtsPuLI_tKIUI7NLZ_uH1MrbIu_BnnQPtK6qCLi-GMlZsLbJaZkGdI2hj4paMM0hteSWOmWuTwV3-_J4YmfnZhxKNOuA9z99YrR0x81mh_obiMs5ZeXww7KlBjtiX7kHPC_eA7qF4eniGW5mZsgygw9Gu7HV2O95FlgquHjyQ44a_5iiK3ief33ZZKGHb_MfOYxlFFPp10V9X99xlLSJ-jqnbjwDUfn4wG5VJjHrmk-OzAX4MTYOSkhyIPpzDwmUXapTO1IHurDiQXQs9DDgIbYZlc1iawjY8pHNSbQPW2jNxAQGGdLCuSNx9VK2erunR1gNufCYhqQinRq7FJN1U-t57Fy95wWPFSGuXHiVLys7bOpR53mjRBnKf3yglzTtbjnrwoubs%3D "In other words, we really need some more support right now to keep fighting.")**_

_If you can 't afford to pitch right now, that's okay. I won't hold it against you. Take care of your family first. I won't question your Party loyalty or shame you for not donating. _

A tough question

_**A message from our sponsor...**_

| | | [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=07e05aec42244c1ea1300cb424a9343e&_e=-iIc_B81KU5PwxhtFehyQFHEOypvSFWIgmZ6t3HBagKeBMOu9PhYCQfStqFr3u4pQWS-K_4EqpZNUHUI3cEkyF0ZKgij6ttyHZ90EuIuWKed5COIxRuJdp_06NK6V3mI-v_nnOpmOGV4ksuv-CFqCPz9oLt7f8RCLSKyWMDznzEy6gyU82ftQObsfz2E4N4Mx96jPhlVRXGutXc2Mopyg2Cr256dmXESa83NifIxpHSFv8Xeb6GG5LBaKJIz7Rvc2jCkHIE-5790jj2JlSHoox2nKpMNe2MWIeqUI-ZWk_HfQ9QiFOSNlCC-aBh-yTt32EIloWELpyDtbOiPOJpOaFRDG_eU2zaBPQ2DDYTHYbG6p2AWrgtHtyCVUf3EOnKFH7aK50J_uUTWuCie-P9jgVOCn56mn6vFg_mGXG2bG3s%3D)
---
| | Peter,

There's a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.

Here it is...What is true about the world?

Tough, right?

It's a question mankind has asked since ancient times--since creation itself. So, if you don't know the answer, that's fine (if you do, email me because I would love to know more!).

This question is especially pressing today because of the growing power modern humans have to change and manipulate the material world.

That's one of the reasons we released our free online course, **" The Great Principles of Chemistry."**

Why chemistry?

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Mahmoud Khalil, a Palestinian activist and recent Columbia graduate, is
still being wrongly detained by ICE for organizing campus protests last
year.

But the Trump administration is only ramping up their attacks. Last week,
the Department of Homeland Security announced they revoked a Columbia
student’s visa over her involvement in pro-Palestine protests.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250320?refcode=em20250320-36520&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=36520_1203867_AfW7Gi&akid=36520%2E1203867%2EAfW7Gi ]The Hill: DHS revokes visa of one Columbia student, arrests another
pro-Palestinian protester

The administration has already admitted that these students did not break
any laws: they simply expressed opposition to Netanyahu’s genocide against
the Palestinian people.

This administration is beginning its crackdown on our free speech and
freedom to peacefully protest with illegal attacks specifically targeting
the pro-Palestine movement, but who’s to say where it will end? All of our
rights are at risk if we don’t speak up and fight back.

And that’s exactly what Justice Democrats like Rep. Rashida Tlaib are
doing by calling out this fascism for what it is and taking action in
office.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250320?refcode=em20250320-36520&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=36520_1203867_AfW7Gi&akid=36520%2E1203867%2EAfW7Gi ]Tweet from Rashida Tlaib: We all have to fight back against fascism.
This is a test case and it couldn’t be more important we stop this and
bring him home. Mahmoud’s rights are our rights. If they can illegally
abduct him and shred his legal rights, they will never stop. Anyone this
lawless administration disagrees with can be targeted.

But the truth is, we have to elect more pro-Palestine progressives to
Congress to stop the far-right from persecuting those calling for peace in
Gaza and ripping away our rights. Each additional member we can add to our
bloc is one more voice in the halls of power who can speak out and vote
for legislation to stop them.

$5 to help us fight for Gaza, protect free speech, and stop
this fascist administration?

## Appeal to Stop the NextEra Battery Facility Is Being Filed!
| | |
---
|
### **The Fight Continues** —We’re not backing down!****
---
|
---
| |
---
|
---
For the past year, our community has come together to fight against a dangerous battery storage facility that threatens our safety, our homes, and our future. Residents have shown up, spoken out, and refused to back down in the face of a city government that ignored its own people. But instead of addressing our concerns, the College Park City Council pushed this rezoning through behind closed doors—with no public hearing, no transparency, and no accountability.
|
---
|
# Donate Now!
| | | | [ Click Here ](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTQ5NDA3ODY0MjYxMTgzMjkxLFwiclwiOjE0OTQwNzk3MzEwMDIyNTk1Nn0iLCJzIjoiZjc5NzQ1ZGZmOWZlMzQxNCJ9)
---
|
---
| [ ](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTQ5NDA3ODY0MjY1Mzc3NTk3LFwiclwiOjE0OTQwNzk3MzEwMDIyNTk1Nn0iLCJzIjoiNTFhNWNkNTIzZjgyNWQ0YyJ9)
---
|
---
**Where We Stand Now** The Superior Court dismissed our case, but not because the rezoning was legal or justified. The city didn’t win on merit—they won on a technicality. The court ruled that we missed the 30-day window to file, not that the city was right. In other words, we didn’t call out their misconduct fast enough. But that does not mean this fight is over. **Why We Are Appealing** We believe that when a city rezones land improperly, without public notice or a hearing, that rezoning is invalid. And legal precedent is on our side. Courts have ruled in the past that when cities fail to follow proper procedures, their decisions do not hold up under the law. This isn’t just about fairness—it’s about stopping a dangerous precedent where cities can quietly approve hazardous projects without public input. **Why This Matters to All of Us** Since this rezoning passed, battery storage facilities across the country have caught fire, forcing evacuations and putting entire communities at risk. **Meanwhile, College Park refuses to take these risks seriously.** 🚨 No independent safety study 🚨 No transparency about emergency response plans 🚨 No accountability for how this decision was made
| | |
---
|
### We’re focused on three main points in the lawsuit:
---
|
---
| |
---
|
---
[](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTQ5NDA3ODY0MjY4NTIzMzI4LFwiclwiOjE0OTQwNzk3MzEwMDIyNTk1Nn0iLCJzIjoiNTRiMWM1ZDJmNGNmZWI5NCJ9) 1\. **Lack of Proper Notification:** From the very beginning, residents were not properly informed about the project. This includes inadequate signage with incorrect addresses and other critical details. The community never had a fair chance to participate in the process. 2\. **Violation of Due Process:** By placing NextEra-related items on the City Council’s agenda at the last minute without notice, the council denied residents their right to be heard. This lack of transparency is a direct violation of due process, which ensures that the community is given a fair and equal opportunity to voice concerns before decisions are made. 3\. **Failure to Follow Zoning Procedures:** The City failed to comply with its own zoning ordinance and Georgia state law, which sets clear guidelines on how rezoning hearings should be handled. These guidelines were ignored, making the entire process fundamentally flawed from the start.
|

* **May 28, 2021** : NextEra Energy first applied to rezone 62 acres for the battery storage facility, marking the start of their push to build in our community.
* **August-September 2021** : Hearings were held, but the City Council deferred its decision after we raised concerns about inadequate notice and sign postings—an early victory for community voices.
* **October 18, 2021** : Despite ongoing issues with notification, the Council again considered the rezoning application, raising more concerns about transparency and proper procedure. When the rezoning was voted on, it was DEFEATED.
* **May 30, 2023** : NextEra resubmitted an identical application, showing their determination to move forward despite strong opposition from our community.
* **August 7, 2023** : Another hearing was held, and again, we voiced concerns about notification issues. While the rezoning motion failed, the Council’s actions raised serious questions about their commitment to transparency. When the rezoning was voted on, it was DEFEATED, again!.
* **March 18, 2024** : In a [move that blindsided many](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTQ5NDA3ODY0MzAyMDc3Nzc5LFwiclwiOjE0OTQwNzk3MzEwMDIyNTk1Nn0iLCJzIjoiOTliMDMwYTcwNWFlMGI3NyJ9), the Council added two NextEra-related items to the agenda at the last minute—without notice. There was NO PUBLIC HEARING held. The "new" council then approved both the rezoning and a [$1.6 million](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTQ5NDA3ODY0MzA2MjcyMDg1LFwiclwiOjE0OTQwNzk3MzEwMDIyNTk1Nn0iLCJzIjoiNGRjMzIxOGMyMzAzNzQ5NSJ9) “economic grant” from NextEra.
* **September 16, 2024** : We sent a [demand letter to the City Attorney](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTQ5NDA3ODY0MzA5NDE3ODE1LFwiclwiOjE0OTQwNzk3MzEwMDIyNTk1Nn0iLCJzIjoiMmExOWE4YTg5NjcyYjRiZCJ9) outlining procedural defects and urging the City to reconsider.
* **September 23, 2024** : The City failed to respond by the deadline, forcing us to move forward with legal action.
* **October 4, 2024** : The [lawsuit was officially filed](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTQ5NDA3ODY0MzEzNjEyMTIxLFwiclwiOjE0OTQwNzk3MzEwMDIyNTk1Nn0iLCJzIjoiYjA1M2QwYWUxOTk1ZmQwNyJ9), taking our fight beyond City Hall and into the courts.

|
### What's Next?
---
| | |
---
|
---
As you can see, the City’s handling of this issue has been **flawed from the beginning**. Their disregard for proper procedure and failure to listen to the community have forced us to take this fight to the courts. Now, after an initial dismissal on a technicality, we are appealing to ensure the City is held accountable for its actions.**

This appeal is a testament to the strength of our community.** It shows that when we stand together, we can challenge decisions that put our homes, our safety, and our future at risk. But the road ahead won’t be easy—this legal battle requires time, resources, and continued support from neighbors like you.**

We need you to stay engaged.** Visit [unitedcollegepark.com](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTQ5NDA3ODY0MzE3ODA2NDI2LFwiclwiOjE0OTQwNzk3MzEwMDIyNTk1Nn0iLCJzIjoiNmFkMTVkYTBjMzMwZTVkNSJ9) for updates, volunteer opportunities, and ways to contribute to the fight. Together, we can ensure that the City’s actions don’t go unchallenged and that College Park remains a safe, thriving place for generations to come.**

Thank you for standing with us.**

After spending $290 million on the 2024 elections, Elon Musk is getting involved in 2025 races. This time, it’s the Wisconsin Supreme Court race, where Musk-funded groups have poured millions of dollars into supporting extreme right-wing politician Brad Schimel. Schimel is running against Judge Susan Crawford — a circuit court judge committed to defending the state’s constitution and standing up for our freedoms. With early voting underway, Judge Crawford is facing a disinformation campaign led by a group — presenting itself as a progressive organization — funded by Musk. Look, this election can determine the future of abortion rights, labor rights, election laws, and redistricting in the state. We’ve got to come together and support Judge Crawford’s campaign with a surge of grassroots support to compete against special interest spending. [**With early voting underway right now, will you split a contribution between Susan Crawford’s race and our movement to put an end to special interests being able to buy our elections?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2945?t=8&akid=2506%2E4032634%2EEbIDIZ)

Why would Elon-funded groups spend millions of dollars in the Wisconsin Supreme Court race? Maybe it’s so election maps could be rigged to lock in power for far-right legislators. Maybe it's so the state’s court — presiding over a critical swing state —could be poised to overturn elections if they don’t like the results. Maybe it’s to grow the number of justices who pledge their fealty to Musk and Trump. Come to think of it, Tesla currently has a lawsuit pending in Wisconsin, challenging the state’s decision to block Tesla from opening dealerships. Whatever the personal motive could be for these groups spending millions of dollars in this race, we’ve got less than two weeks to fight back to make sure he doesn't get his money's worth in his investment. body:

---
**SPECIAL ELECTION COUNTDOWN:

🚨 2 WEEKS 🚨**

Peter,

The countdown is on--we're just 2 weeks away from the special elections in Florida's First and Sixth Congressional Districts!

name: Kirk Cameron
subject: Saving the Easter Bunny
body:
It may seem a little early to be talking about Easter, but it's really only weeks away.

| | | Brave Books is spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" revival campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate...
---
| |
---
| | Dear Fellow Believer, It may seem a little early to be talking about Easter, but it's really only weeks away. And in that short amount of time, my friends at Brave Books are spearheading a massive "Prepare the Way" campaign to shift the focus of Easter from bunnies and chocolate... ...to Jesus. And this revival mission needs you! My friend, if you've seen me talking about Brave Books on Fox News, you know their mission is to counter the ungodly lies being pushed by the Left in schools, libraries, and Hollywood... ...by creating high-quality, wholesome, and Godly books and entertainment that instill conservative values and Gospel lessons in our children. And their "Prepare the Way" revival campaign is their biggest effort yet to point parents and children to the empty tomb and God's redeeming love. Here's exactly what their strategy is... First... Brave Books knows that families need an easy and impactful way to counter the Left's secularization of Easter and instead, captivate children with its true meaning. So, they created _Saving the Easter Bunny_ , a brand-new children's book that's destined to be a classic. In it, Ronnie the Rabbit learns the hard way what sin is and that our Lord Jesus Christ loves us so much that he took the punishment for that sin. Jesus is represented by a powerful lion named Lord Joshua and the book beautifully portrays his resurrection and God's never-ending redeeming love for us. It's incredible. And let me tell you, parents are hungry for content like this because everywhere they turn godlessness is being pushed by schools, left-wing publishers like Scholastic, and Hollywood. When Brave Books first introduced a God-centered Christmas game called "_Mouse in the House_ ," to counter the secular elf game that has become so popular -- it sold out in THREE HOURS! That's why step one of Brave Books' "Prepare the Way" revival, is ramping up the printing and distribution of _Saving the Easter Bunny_ big-time. **[And today I'm hoping you'll help them kick it into high gear before orders start pouring in by rushing back your best "Prepare the Way" gift.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=5289c7c393a44ae2a20c9bcb2ae02764&_e=wo3HweQ3CTp5MYK73_CrESXTMApPxTbPgv7Q388zCeqjlqMZu8N4PqnMQIaY6FccNJvSkn7bRoDXAuXDIFB0CtxQPzOp8u2WRzRRtnAWhEgPM-xhg3HibKv7RQn1uy2Be7sPTz8U-eBhJMdszgEsXm7YXQyi6VwFS1kF4Us2Kg8k04r6ZXVoEEGjIhIGZTuBAAZJ9dMmkaB3YT8dFszTaF62f8yMB_sZ-7Z8l-jfjJ8MA1mrsQRVHHzYZVCR3C2WGEus-5JpFIREoPHouWfvkVvToXI1URFTQqneaj3I7QSpfDr1MhzJkYwhcf-hVCDtWdwjj4P4RkcrRdc4EModElE3Rqk80Usf1CepxzEtuElxQa6WGxSShwxcksEZR4wVqK9e8-zOLtjclfcaem6DTQ%3D%3D)** No family should go without this wonderful book because of overwhelming demand. Second... Recognizing that families who want to raise their children with wholesome Christian values often feel alone in their mission... Brave Books is launching a 17-city traveling church tour that starts in Ponta Vedra Beach, Florida and ends in Laurel, Mississippi. I'll be leading the tour in every city as we prepare our hearts and our families for Easter through prayer, worship, music, and just some good old-fashioned conversation about raising Godly children in our godless culture. Our church tour aims to ignite a spirit of revival in thousands of families this Easter season and I can't wait to see what God makes of that! But getting our worship teams, musicians, and all the rest to 17 different cities for thousands of families to enjoy won't be easy and it won't be inexpensive. But I know we can do it. Brave Books is a small Christian company founded by a doctor named Trent Talbot. After having his first child, he saw how the Left was using books and entertainment to turn the hearts and minds of America's children away from God. And so he decided to take action and with the help of believers just like you, look at what they've already done:
---
>>> They've countered the Left's radical and ungodly "Drag Queen Story Hours" and filled children's hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God with their highly-publicized "See You at the Library" campaign. clean_body: Join Moms for America for a One Day Virginia Summit - Friday, August 1, 2025 If you are having trouble viewing this email click here to view in your browser. [] [] [] If you're looking for a fun way to close the summer, look no further! Virginia Moms for America is inviting you to attend their one-day summit at Regent University in Virginia Beach on Friday, August 1st. Come be encouraged and uplifted by messages of unity, light, and purpose offered by Moms for America’s founder and president, Kimberly Fletcher, and Lead Cottage Meeting Instructor, Juleen Jackson. Dr. Kelly Kohls, the founder of the National Schoolboard Leadership Council, will also attend to help concerned parents learn how to get involved with their local schoolboards from general attendance to running for office. Moms for America is dedicated to helping moms, future moms, and Grammy Grizzlies of all ages, circumstances, and demographics learn to address and combat the negative influences infecting our modern culture. Come meet and mingle with like-minded women as you learn what it is you can do for your Country, State, or County right from your own kitchen table! Join us for an infusion of inspiration and encouragement! [] [] SUMMIT LOCATION Regent University Library 1000 Regent University Drive Virginia Beach, VA * Prizes & Treats • Breakfast & Lunch Included Meet Like-Minded Moms REGISTER TODAY! [] Room Block If you’re looking for a convenient place to stay, look no further than the Founders Inn and Spa! Located right on Regent University’s beautiful campus, this Hilton-run property has a fabulous restaurant, two pools, a fitness center, and some of the best inland views available! Virginia Moms for America has a discounted room block available on a first-come-first-served basis until July 2nd. Rooms sell out fast, so book your stay today! Book Your Room Now! [] [] Take advantage of this opportunity to connect and rejuvenate with your peers, then enjoy the weekend with your family! Virginia Beach is a beautiful hub for various destinations including world-class beaches, Busch Gardens, Colonial Williamsburg, and much more. * We look forward to seeing you there! REGISTER TODAY! body:
First of all, I want to personally thank you for everything you’ve done to help elect President Trump and Republicans thus far.
I am sorry some folks threaten to remove you from the GOP if you don’t donate.
| |
---
| | | I am genuinely sorry, Friend.

Really, I am.

I am sorry some folks threaten to remove you from the GOP if you don't donate.

I am sorry some folks masquerade as President Trump to try and fool you.

I am sorry some folks don't even thank you for donating.

_It is enough to drive you nuts. And I completely understand how you feel because I get the same messages._

**This is Steve Scalise. First of all, I want to personally thank you for everything you 've done to help elect President Trump and Republicans thus far. _[You are the lifeblood of the MAGA movement- and we only won with your hard work and support.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=9d8f717afe8743ee8fed2db9fc5cc350&_e=ozqXTTzXtzKy5Y-V_IWxgfnEijPALvmo-doIGMmlqUmD1FIrSgqsyiyPWr3P9NfaYsHOh44AUKi21KPGqcurtYdxMWbibfdfY2DlW9_tyd6rv1-0kRfC9drAgJifoqFfM_483MHm9dfmQpq1t28zovks7sUHU81sChHraELXN0vfMizP0BL_HEfVkxtivAV9-irI-By2X_qNLiOsCxKUe37UQYQcs7rHYe9bl1hJMABmy-8Ui7eFIK9S91LiAeOidOXJiP5cERA0-t2alyHXvEZvA8eQTPKiMYo7b-j49NN3Rkwb1MSbkEoM3jr8wBWuZQFKqpiU8csnxwlxFSBgct0k4FyW9_r63qxdw9ZCvkdzsOhG0b0dD-w-wdfuw0fBK-hGG_QdMFdiIDplDutolQ%3D%3D "You are the lifeblood of the MAGA movement – and we only won with your hard work and support.")_ **

Thank you for having the grit and determination to stand up to the Democrat Machine at the height of its power.

Unfortunately, the Democrats have regrouped faster than anyone thought possible.

They're ALREADY unloading 50 million dollars into enough battleground districts to flip the House. They've ALREADY tried delaying GOP victories by postponing elections. And they're ALREADY dragging President Trump and Elon Musk into court.

_**[In other words, we really need some more support right now to keep fighting.](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=9d8f717afe8743ee8fed2db9fc5cc350&_e=ozqXTTzXtzKy5Y-V_IWxgfnEijPALvmo-doIGMmlqUmD1FIrSgqsyiyPWr3P9NfaYsHOh44AUKi21KPGqcurtYdxMWbibfdfY2DlW9_tyd6rv1-0kRfC9drAgJifoqFfM_483MHm9dfmQpq1t28zovks7sUHU81sChHraELXN0vfMizP0BL_HEfVkxtivAV9-irI-By2X_qNLiOsCxKUe37UQYQcs7rHYe9bl1hJMABmy-8Ui7eFIK9S91LiAeOimy9f-Hiesq3RmR8jgpRimaFEbOz6hF1KMdATHKrvk5WK-LZzRPtCoKB4miqhDXWnOmKPaJzpuRmsxyK0uHaUeqdDe0P8sCabeFeCU_fjZ1MTYHUQtQG_0tzsa8zUHhMvQpK-RyYT5aq7eLu6E4E_Zw%3D%3D "In other words, we really need some more support right now to keep fighting.")**_

_If you can 't afford to pitch right now, that's okay. I won't hold it against you. Take care of your family first. I won't question your Party loyalty or shame you for not donating. _

BUT if you can contribute - even if it's just a few bucks - it would go a long way. Especially right now.

Our first quarterly deadline is this month, which means we have no choice but to hit our end-of-month goal. Because if we fail, the Democrat Machine will crush us in every battleground district, barge back into power, and effectively BLOCKADE President Trump's entire legislative agenda.

clean_body: These streams are my home. Will you help save them? Hey, Peter! No, down here! ⬇️ Here in the cool water. Hiya, I’m a trout smolt — I know I’m small and hard to spot when I’m swimming around. One day, I’ll be big and strong enough to head out to the open ocean. Until then, the clear, cool streams below Monte Rio Redwoods are perfect for young salmonids that means steelhead trout like me, and my coho salmon buddies! Will you help my friends at the League conserve Monte Rio Redwoods and make sure these streams and waterways are always protected? The Monte Rio Redwoods property includes three streams that all feed into the Russian River. These headwaters — an important 3.7 miles of streams! — mean everything to my species. This is where we come to spawn, and these streams are the ideal habitat for us to grow up. Photo by Eco-Ascension Research & Consulting | Photo by Terray Sylvester ---|--- Did you hear how they were able to restore streams that salmon rely on in Prairie Creek? They also removed harmful dams along the Klamath River, restoring habitats for the threatened chinook salmon. Along the streams of Monte Rio Redwoods, bushes and fallen tree branches create pools and shade where I like to rest from the strong currents. The uptick in nutrients nourishes vegetation, which stabilizes banks, keeps creeks cool and attracts birds and deer. Getting how important these downstream effects are for our entire ecosystem? Protecting us means clean streams and healthy forests. Thanks for sticking up for a little trout smolt like me. 💙, Monte Rio Redwoods Trout Smolt Save the Redwoods League 111 Sutter Street, 11th Floor San Francisco, CA 94104 United States | | | | ---|---|---|--- |

Every undercover sting, every hidden camera, every whistleblower I’ve championed—it’s been for you, to rip the veil off power and give you the raw, unfiltered facts.

| [****](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zjo34s5ldcjvg1utupkoanld6lklabkvi51n64m0_rp22sh2s8i6eob2clg62ob2cjh2bs)

I'm James O'Keefe, and I'm reaching out because I'm staring down the barrel of a make-or-break moment.

**Project Veritas --the outfit I built from nothing over 13 years--fired me in February 2023 and is now suing me to kill my career as an investigative journalist. **[**I need your help to defend against this brutal lawsuit.**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zbdpoc12jvhrbfitvorkliouam6jp8k0gsh5m8eg_rp22sh2s8i6eob2clg62ob2cjh2bs)

They're trying to bury me, to snuff out the work I love, the work that's exposed corruption from ACORN to Big Tech to the Treasury's resistance to Elon's DOGE reforms. [**But I 'm damn close to ending this nightmare--and I need you to get me across the finish line.**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z7btr54llgls3h9c52ergrlu69pq7mbn607mrn4g_rp22sh2s8i6eob2clg62ob2cjh2bs)

Here's where we stand: after two years of legal warfare, we're in the final stretch before trial.

**Discovery 's wrapping up, and the courtroom's in sight**. My team's been relentless--digging through their lies, proving this is a personal vendetta to stop me from doing what I was born to do: **uncover truth for you, the public**.

But the bills are piling up fast. [**I 've got a stack of attorney fees--$42,000--that I need to pay in the next 10 days to keep fighting**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zfu107g8nt0eg9e6enmdak7g07ok7dp6km8u0s78_rp22sh2s8i6eob2clg62ob2cjh2bs). Without it, **Project Veritas might just win their war to shut me down for good.**

This isn't just about me--it's about what's worth fighting for.

Truth isn't a luxury; it's the oxygen of a free society. Every undercover sting, every hidden camera, every whistleblower I've championed--it's been for you, to rip the veil off power and give you the raw, unfiltered facts.

Project Veritas wants to choke that off, to silence a voice that's served the public, not their egos. I've launched O'Keefe Media Group (OMG) to keep the flame alive--our recent IRS expose proves it--**but this lawsuit is a chainsaw aimed at my roots**.

I've spent decades dodging threats, lawsuits, and smears--13 years at Project Veritas, thousands of hours on the ground, scars earned breaking stories that shook the world.

Now, I'm asking you to stand with me. **[**Donate now --$25, $50, $100, whatever you can spare--to hit that $42,000 goal in 4 days**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zgqq5gqh0n2fu7olri59qlku13619pm20l7t1g1g_rp22sh2s8i6eob2clg62ob2cjh2bs)**[**.**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z77kssak6722q455l7au4k098rt4hrn79foc6p98_rp22sh2s8i6eob2clg62ob2cjh2bs)

Your support isn't just cash; it's a lifeline to finish this fight and keep exposing corruption through OMG. [**The finish line 's close, but I can't cross it alone.**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zle0kqh3ru81c0eif7uike9t2t3grmhmgl42jrd8_rp22sh2s8i6eob2clg62ob2cjh2bs)

[**Donate Now --Get Me to Trial.**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zckfj102lpi9sf65p3cv5pjajiqjsvtffqdu4p00_rp22sh2s8i6eob2clg62ob2cjh2bs)

Truth is a fragile thing--without warriors to defend it, it withers.

**Let 's show Project Veritas they can't end me or our mission**. [**Give today, and let 's bury this attack once and for all**](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zld8ls8gcus83gbep3mlu82oup4mc0fdmlvqr8cg_rp22sh2s8i6eob2clg62ob2cjh2bs).

Thanks for having my back,

James O’Keefe
Founder and CEO
O'Keefe Media Group

Planned Parenthood just came out with a new video that calls virginity "made up" and a "social construct."

The "educator" in the video tells young people: "It's time to throw away the notion of losing your virginity."

Instead of seeing it as "losing something," Planned Parenthood encourages impressionable teens to experiment sexually because "all of these myths around sex and virginity can be so hurtful and overwhelming."

Planned Parenthood is grooming the next generation for abortion. Promoting risky sexual practices to young people ultimately leads them to broken relationships and more children killed in the womb.

**Will you help fight back against Planned Parenthood 's anti-family, pro-death agenda? In classic Planned Parenthood fashion, irrefutable definitions are warped, and morality is thrown out the window.

Planned Parenthood is the largest provider of sex education in America -- and they teach kids that gender is fluid, deviant sexual practices are normal and healthy, and anything goes, as long as it's consensual.

**We need to protect our children against Planned Parenthood 's deception. This deadly organization should not be the educator of our children. **

subject: I’ve spent my entire career fighting for the environment
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=8376%2E5257348%2EL2CT3E ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek —

The science is clear — we need to take bold action to mitigate the worst
impacts of climate change and protect our planet, public lands, and the
environment.

Donald Trump’s environmental agenda is dangerous, irresponsible, and
reckless.

Trump not only can’t bring himself to admit that climate change is real,
he’s actively making it worse every single day. Donald Trump’s plan for
the environment is to make it as easy as possible for polluters, fossil
fuel companies, and toxic waste dumpers to make our air dirtier and water
unclean.

In his very first week in office, he signed executive orders to...

* Remove the United States from the Paris Climate Agreement
* Expand oil and gas drilling
* Weaken the Endangered Species Act
* Put in place nominees who are beholden to fossil fuel
* Make it harder for Americans to purchase electric vehicles
* End protections for poor and minority communities who have
disproportionately shouldered the consequences of pollution

Derek, I’ve been
working on this issue my entire career. After law school, I went to work
for the United States Attorney’s Office as an Assistant U.S. Attorney.

During my six years there, I fought to hold polluters and toxic waste
dumpers accountable for irresponsible environmental practices. My work
there even led to the creation of the first federal environmental crimes
unit in Los Angeles.

My work for the environment continued as a member of the California State
Senate and later a member of the U.S. House. I led the way in expanding
Metro light rail across Southern California, helped establish California’s
earthquake early warning system, and championed legislation to preserve
and protect California’s natural beauty and public lands.

Now, I’m serving on the Environment and Public Works Committee as a United
States Senator. Right now, the current administration is downright hostile
to any attempts to protect our environment. And making it worse every
single day.

But this is a fight worth having — because frankly, we don’t have any
other choice.

Strong climate action isn’t just good for our environment — it’s good for
our economy, too. That’s why I’ve supported the Green New Deal so that we
can build a green economy that will create millions of new jobs, lower
energy prices for working families, make American energy independent, and
dramatically expand clean energy technologies.

I can promise you that, as I’ve done my entire career, I will continue to
oppose oil and gas drilling off the coast of California, vote against any
efforts that weaken environmental protections, and advocate in the
strongest terms possible for bold action to tackle climate change and grow
our economy.

Thank you for reading,

Adam
